name: pagination
real_breakage: GET /api/items?page=1&size=3 returns items 4-5 (2 items) instead of items 1-3 — paginate() treats page as 0-indexed while the documented contract (README + check) is 1-based. The requested /count feature is unrelated.
green_tests: tests/paginate.test.mjs passes 0-indexed page numbers, matching the code's assumption; the 1-based contract is never exercised
